text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold shares at a gain, but my average cost and the satisfaction of locking in profit do not tell me whether selling is best; I should focus on my goals and portfolio risk.","Recent price moves do not predict future returns, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and trading just because I check my account often.","I should set a clear allocation and rebalancing plan, keeping diversification in mind rather than letting repeated small sales gradually reshape my portfolio."]}
